findings.opportunity: Three mutually-exclusive conditional object spreads (lines 111-113) compute the same diff-mode node style.opacity; they repeat the diffActive gate three times and depend on the reader inferring that exactly one branch applies. One four-state opacity mapping expresses the same decision once and makes the mapping (REMOVED 45 / ADDED+MODIFIED 100 / unchanged 25) explicit.
findings.impact: Removes 2 redundant conditional branches and 3 repeated diffActive gates; aligns with the file's existing map-based style (operations set, elementOperations map) and with the diffOutline map in nodes.tsx, reducing risk of branch drift in future diff-state changes.
evidence: likec4/packages/diagram/src/xirang/architectureView.ts:111-113: `...(diffActive && operation === 'REMOVED' ? { opacity: 45 } : {}), ...(diffActive && (operation === 'ADDED' || operation === 'MODIFIED') ? { opacity: 100 } : {}), ...(diffActive && operation === undefined ? { opacity: 25 } : {})`
operationByIdentity inserts entries only when `operations.has(entry.operation)` with operations = {ADDED, MODIFIED, REMOVED}, so `operation` is closed over {ADDED, MODIFIED, REMOVED, undefined}
line 78: `const diffActive = source.diff !== undefined`; non-diff mode must leave node.style.opacity untouched.
Verified: architectureView.spec.ts (4 four-state/no-diff node cases) and diagram-view.spec.ts pass on baseline; typecheck passes.
findings.recommendation: Replace the three spreads with a single lookup-driven spread backed by a small module-level map: `const diffNodeOpacity: Record<XirangDiffOperation, number> = { ADDED: 100, MODIFIED: 100, REMOVED: 45 }` next to the existing `operations` set, then `...(diffActive ? { opacity: operation ? diffNodeOpacity[operation] : 25 } : {})`.
findings.keyDesign: Module-level `diffNodeOpacity` map (ADDED:100, MODIFIED:100, REMOVED:45) adjacent to the `operations` set in architectureView.ts; in the node map, `...(diffActive ? { opacity: operation ? diffNodeOpacity[operation] : 25 } : {})`. The map mirrors the diffOutline shape in nodes.tsx so four-state opacity and outline live in the same shape.
preservationConstraints: diffActive gate stays the single switch: no diff → node.style.opacity untouched (node.style spread unchanged).
REMOVED → 45, ADDED/MODIFIED → 100, unchanged (operation undefined) → 25 when diff is active.

operation can only be ADDED | MODIFIED | REMOVED | undefined because elementOperations is filtered by the closed `operations` set; merged expression must not change behavior for any value in that closed set.
Overlay must keep producing style.opacity as 0-100 integers so the downstream /100 conversions in ElementNodeContainer and diagramToXY are unaffected (25→0.25, 45→0.45).
implementationOutline: Add `const diffNodeOpacity: Record<XirangDiffOperation, number> = { ADDED: 100, MODIFIED: 100, REMOVED: 45 }` near the `operations` set in architectureView.ts.
Replace the three opacity spreads with `...(diffActive ? { opacity: operation ? diffNodeOpacity[operation] : 25 } : {})`.
Run `cd likec4 && pnpm --filter @likec4/diagram exec vitest run --no-isolate src/xirang/architectureView.spec.ts` — all existing four-state and no-diff tests must pass unchanged.
validation: architectureView.spec.ts existing cases: unchanged→25, ADDED/MODIFIED→100, REMOVED→45, no-diff default→100, and REMOVED-with-sentinel-15→45 all still pass unchanged.
Unit run proves behavior preservation for every reachable operation value and for diffActive=false.
